definitions.explanation: Something so obvious that it requires no explanation or proof. Used in both academic/logical contexts and everyday speech to mean something is undeniably clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自明|じめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自明|じめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理|り}だ。
examples.english: It is an obvious truth that there is no success without effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、もはや{自明|じめい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧だろう。
examples.english: It can now be said to be self-evident that global warming is progressing.

notes:
A somewhat formal word meaning something is so clear it needs no proof or explanation. Common in academic, logical, and argumentative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自明|じめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{理|り}: self-evident truth; truism
- {自明|じめい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと: something obvious
- {自明|じめい}な⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: self-evident fact

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{明白|めいはく}→明白：14956_meihaku⟧: obvious, clear — emphasizes clarity of evidence
- ⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧: clear, evident — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧: natural, of course — emphasizes that something is expected

FORMS:
{自|じ} (self) + {明|めい} (clear, bright) — clear by itself, without external proof.
